description: 1000NM Torque Impact Wrench- BUILDSKILL BLDC Impact wrench features a 1000NM torque, ensuring strong, stable, and low-noise performance for demanding impact wrench applications. Powerful Brushless Copper Motor - BUILDSKILL BLDC Impact wrench features a bruhsless copper motor ensuring to deliver high performance with low power consumption & offers increased product life. 21V Dual 4.0Ah Battery with Fast Charger - Includes two 21V 4.0Ah lithium-ion batteries and a 2.0A fast charger for quick 1-hour recharge. Provides a runtime of 50 minutes at no load, keeping your impact wrench cordless tool powered longer. The runtime will vary depending on the material. Operating time will vary according to material density and load. Reverse Self-Stop Mode - BUILDSKILL 1000NM Cordless Impact Wrench automatically shuts off the tool and its impacts within a second or two once a fastener is sufficiently loosened, preventing it from flying off, getting lost in tight spots (like overhead), or spinning freely, giving users more control during bolt removal and increasing efficiency for tasks like removing lug nuts or suspension bolts. 3 Variable Speed Modes - Offers 3 speed levels (2200 / 1750 / 1400 RPM) with matching impact rates (2800 / 2550 / 2100 IPM) for precision control, ideal as both an adjustable wrench and a high-torque removal tool.
